sources.title: [2603.00729] Qwen3-Coder-Next Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: We present Qwen3-Coder-Next, an open-weight language model specialized for coding agents. Qwen3-Coder-Next is an 80-billion-parameter model that activates only 3 billion parameters during inference, enabling strong coding capability with efficient inference. In this work, we explore how far strong training recipes can push the capability limits of models with small parameter footprints. To ...

Quantized in float16. sources.snippet: We are announcing Qwen3-Coder, our most agentic code model to date. Qwen3-Coder is available in multiple sizes, Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct, Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct, Qwen3-Coder-Next, offering exceptional performance in both coding and agentic tasks.
